rationale.text: The page has the HTML 5 doctype and holds a u element, and no other listed element. A u element would be forbidden under another doctype, so the page does not meet the plain absence route, but the methodology checks for u only when the doctype does not correspond to HTML 5, and the glossary says the same. The exception applies, so the test is met. The custom check never faults u under the HTML 5 doctype and answers no_fault, so the finding is passed at full and needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only. This is also the first half of the mixed pair: an element allowed by the exception beside text styled by CSS.

citations.quote: Vérifier l’absence de l’élément `<u>` uniquement si le DOCTYPE du document ne correspond pas à HTML 5 ;
L’élément <u> est interdit uniquement si le DOCTYPE du document ne correspond pas à HTML 5.
